items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the comparison transformation from the Cech complex of a covering to the derived global sections functor, and the resulting maps on Cech cohomology groups (statement lines 1360-1375). The proof resolves the sheaf injectively and identifies the derived sections with the sections of the resolution (proof lines 1377-1390), constructs the comparison map and uses acyclicity to obtain the transformation (proof lines 1390-1405), and reads off the maps on cohomology (proof lines 1405-1413). The non-formal content is the identification of the derived functor with the resolution used to compare. The claim is H2: one construction from a chosen resolution.
